about: Forge editions and the features each turns on. Every download is the same; a signed licence file (shared/forge_licence.py) picks the edition, and with none Forge is the default edition. A feature belongs to the lowest edition that has it; an edition has its own features plus those of the edition it inherits. when_off is what a feature does when this edition lacks it: hidden or read_only, never anything that keeps a user from their own data. owner is hub or an app folder in apps/. Ask through shared/forge_edition.py: enabled("feature"). Declared, not yet enforced: no existing code path calls enabled() until the owner picks the editions, so a Forge with no licence (his own laptop included) loses nothing, the Business look lock included.

free.label: Forge
free.what: Every app, for personal use. Export and backups are always here.

plus.label: Forge Plus
plus.what: For one person who wants to support Forge: the beta channel and extras.

business.label: Forge Business
business.what: Use at a business, per seat: the Business look's lock and company update mirror.

beta_channel.what: Get beta builds from the update feed

business_lock.what: Password lock for the Business look

update_mirror.what: Read updates from the company's own address
